data.name: Blind Route
data.detailed_description:
FOLLOW THE VOICE YOU TRUST ON A PATH YOU CANNOT SEE.

BlindRoute is a sci-fi 3D puzzle platformer built around communication, trust, and quick decisions. Blind and Guide players experience the same route with different information. Describe what you see, trust what you hear, and move as one team.

TWO DISTINCT ROLES

Blind players cannot see the safe route. They must rely on their Guides to identify platforms, hazards, and the correct direction.

Guide players study the route, detect danger, and lead their Blind teammate to safety. Not every role receives the same information, making clear communication the key to survival.

CHANGING ROUTES AND HAZARDS

• Complete procedurally generated sci-fi routes.

• Collect keys, open real gates, and watch out for deceptive paths.

• Overcome moving and rotating platforms, elevators, and physics-based hazards.

• Reach checkpoints while carefully managing your limited lives.

• Push opponents and disrupt rival teams to gain an advantage.

PLAY ALONE OR AS A TEAM

• Complete solo routes as a Guide.

• Cooperate in teams built around Blind and Guide roles.

• Race rival teams across the same dangerous course.

• Compete in solo Guide races and 4v4 team matches.

• Create private lobbies with friends or join online matchmaking.

YOUR VOICE IS YOUR TEAM'S MOST IMPORTANT TOOL

Built-in team voice chat keeps every warning and direction close at hand. Listen to positional environmental audio, locate moving hazards, and trust your team in the darkness.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 21H1 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required. Internet connection and microphone are required for online multiplayer and voice chat.

  • Sound Card: Core Audio-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection and microphone are required for online multiplayer and voice chat.
